issues: There is a significant mismatch between the resources requested and the command being run. The script requests 6 tasks (`#FLUX: -n 6`) but executes a single, serial `matlab` command. This will likely result in 5 allocated task slots sitting idle, which is an inefficient use of cluster resources.

The script relies on a command-line argument (`$1`) to be passed at submission time. If this argument is not provided, the `NCL` variable will be empty, which will likely cause the matlab script or the output redirection to fail.

The script uses both a Flux output directive (`-o log_%J.out`) and shell redirection (`>> log_$NCL`). This can be confusing, as the primary job output and errors might go to the file specified by `-o`, while the application-specific output goes elsewhere. The file `log_%J.out` may end up being empty.
